ic_device.name: NA555, NE555, SA555, SE555
ic_device.description: Precision timing circuits capable of producing accurate time delays or oscillation; astable or monostable operation; TTL-compatible output can sink or source up to 200mA.

pins.name: TRIG
pins.description: Start of timing input. TRIG < ½ CONT sets output high and discharge open
pins.evidence: Start of timing input. TRIG < ½ CONT sets output high

pins.name: RESET
pins.description: Active low reset input forces output and discharge low.
pins.evidence: Active low reset input forces output and discharge low.

pins.name: CONT
pins.description: Controls comparator thresholds, Outputs 2/3 × VCC, allows bypass capacitor connection

pins.name: THRES
pins.description: End of timing input. THRES > CONT sets output low and discharge low
pins.evidence: End of timing input. THRES > CONT sets output low

pins.name: DISCH
pins.description: Open collector output to discharge timing capacitor
pins.evidence: Open collector output to discharge timing capacitor

pins.name: VCC
pins.description: Input supply voltage, 4.5V to 16V. SE555 maximum is 18V.

port_dependencies.condition: Operation is specified for supplies of 5V to 15V
Maximum output sink and discharge sink current are greater for higher VCC
TRIG < ½ CONT sets output high and discharge open
THRES > CONT sets output low and discharge low
Active low reset input forces output and discharge low
Active low reset input forces output and discharge low

functional_blocks.name: Resistor divider
functional_blocks.description: Sets trigger level to approximately one-third of supply voltage and threshold level to approximately two-thirds of supply voltage

functional_blocks.name: Threshold Logic
functional_blocks.description: Threshold comparator resets the flip-flop when THRES > CONT

functional_blocks.name: Trigger Logic
functional_blocks.description: Trigger comparator sets the flip-flop when TRIG < ½ CONT

functional_blocks.name: Latch
functional_blocks.description: Flip-flop set by trigger and reset by threshold or RESET

functional_blocks.name: Output Drive Stage
functional_blocks.description: High current timer output signal capable of sinking or sourcing up to 200mA
